instruction: Look at hard-06_seed.dxf. Create the hard AutoCAD drawing 'heat-exchanger tube sheet with staggered pitch' using exact model-space coordinates in millimeters. Create or keep these layers exactly as needed: ANNOTATION, CENTER, CUTOUT, HOLE, OUTLINE, REFERENCE, TUBE. Straight geometry may be LINE entities or straight LWPOLYLINE edges; every listed rounded or slot end must be an ARC entity using the listed start/end angles in degrees. Use AutoCAD rectangular ARRAY commands for the repeated centerlines and tube circles described below, then explode or otherwise convert the arrays before export so the final DXF contains direct LINE/LWPOLYLINE, CIRCLE, ARC, and TEXT/MTEXT entities. Required straight segments: OUTLINE (20,0)->(240,0); OUTLINE (260,20)->(260,160); OUTLINE (240,180)->(20,180); OUTLINE (0,160)->(0,20); CENTER vertical array from sample (65,30)->(65,150) with 5 columns, column spacing 30, row count 1, yielding x=65,95,125,155,185; CENTER horizontal array from sample (45,45)->(215,45) with 5 rows, row spacing 22, column count 1, yielding y=45,67,89,111,133; CUTOUT (100,25)->(160,25); CUTOUT (100,15)->(160,15); CUTOUT (100,165)->(160,165); CUTOUT (100,155)->(160,155). Required circles: TUBE staggered array A from sample center (65,45) radius 4.5 with 5 columns at x spacing 30 and 3 rows at y spacing 44, yielding x=65,95,125,155,185 at y=45,89,133; TUBE staggered array B from sample center (80,67) radius 4.5 with 4 columns at x spacing 30 and 2 rows at y spacing 44, yielding x=80,110,140,170 at y=67,111; HOLE center (45,150) radius 9; HOLE center (215,30) radius 9; HOLE center (45,30) radius 6; HOLE center (215,150) radius 6. Required arcs: OUTLINE center (20,20) radius 20 start 180 end 270; OUTLINE center (240,20) radius 20 start 270 end 0; OUTLINE center (240,160) radius 20 start 0 end 90; OUTLINE center (20,160) radius 20 start 90 end 180; CUTOUT center (100,20) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (160,20) radius 5 start 270 end 90; CUTOUT center (100,160) radius 5 start 90 end 270; CUTOUT center (160,160) radius 5 start 270 end 90. Required text strings: ANNOTATION text ACAD-H06; ANNOTATION text TUBE-SHEET 23X. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
